name: CNSE ao Cubo 2025

venue.name: Colégio Nossa Senhora da Esperança

information:
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54123-informacao-importante-important-information), [Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54122-perguntas-frequentes-faq) e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54121-associados-aps-aps-associates).
​
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54123-informacao-importante-important-information), the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54122-perguntas-frequentes-faq) and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54121-associados-aps-aps-associates).
